items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

ctx.x: I was thinking, trying to think about some of the people I know of from Donaldsonville. There was a guitar player named Joey Sales or something. But I guess he moved down here. Joey Sales?
His son is Manuel Sales. He also plays the guitar here. He's telling me. I just thought you might have run across here.
